changelog:
All areas in one list is now the default for CSM settings. Existing explicit layout choices are preserved.
Added an adaptive area tile grid and a full-list jump selector: nine settings navigation layouts selectable in Appearance.
Removed redundant category headings that repeat their first control; distinct settings and prerequisite/safety summaries remain intact.
Tablet Grid Columns and Library Grid Columns now have distinct labels. Native storage, search, large text and TV D-pad navigation remain supported.
message: Dev build v852 - Default full list, tile grid and jump navigation
